description: Runs IRS Publication 590-A Worksheet 1-2 (the deductible part of a traditional IRA contribution when you or your spouse is covered by a plan at work) and Worksheet 2-2 (the reduced Roth IRA contribution limit) for 2026 or 2027 on a modified AGI, line by line, with the spousal IRA rule and the $10 rounding and $200 floor: free when the MAGI is given. With a connected QuantCalc PRO licence or Tax Season Pass it also figures the MAGI from wages and other income and the federal and state tax the deduction saves (New Jersey, Pennsylvania and Massachusetts allow no IRA deduction). The limits and ranges are the website's IRA and Roth income-limit pages' own figures (the 2027 limit and ranges are projections under the statutory indexing formula until the IRS publishes them, labelled as such). Not tax advice.

age.description: Your age on December 31 of the tax year (18-110): 50 or older adds the catch-up.

amount.description: The contribution for the year. Default: your full limit.

contribution_type.description: traditional (default): the deductible part and the tax it saves. roth: your Roth IRA limit at this MAGI.

covered.description: You are covered by a retirement plan at work (the W-2 'Retirement plan' box). Default false.

filing_status.description: single, mfj, hoh, mfs (lived with the spouse at some time in the year) or mfs_apart (married filing separately, lived apart all year: treated as unmarried).

magi.description: Modified AGI. With it the worksheets run without a licence. Without it the engine's AGI for the income given is used (licence needed).

other_income.description: Other taxable income (interest, other ordinary income). Default 0.

spouse_age.description: Joint return only: the spouse's age. Default: the same as age.

spouse_covered.description: mfj or mfs: your spouse is covered by a plan at work. Default false.

spouse_ira_contributions.description: Joint return only: the spouse's own IRA contributions (the spousal IRA rule). Default 0.

spouse_wages.description: Joint return only: the spouse's wages. Default 0.

state.description: Optional two-letter state of residence, or DC: adds the state tax saving (licence needed). Without it no state saving is figured.

tax_year.description: 2026 (default) or 2027. 2027: the limits and phase-out ranges are the 2027 pages' PROJECTIONS under each limit's statutory indexing formula (the IRS's 2027 retirement-plan limits notice is not out yet), labelled as such; the tax on the IRS's published 2027 amounts (Rev. Proc. 2026-35); the state line on each state's 2026 rules, labelled. Stated in the result.

wages.description: Your wages (W-2 box 1): your compensation. Default 0.

name: ira_deduction_and_roth_limit
title: Traditional IRA deduction and Roth IRA limit at an income (2026; 2027 ranges projected)
